# oodle_genai_evaluator (Resource)

Runs a GenAI eval template against live traffic: which spans it scores, how often, and how span fields map onto the template's variables.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Runs an eval template against live traffic. variable_mapping is what
# connects the template's vars to fields on the trace.
resource "oodle_genai_evaluator" "answer_quality" {
  name              = "answer-quality"
  eval_template_id  = oodle_genai_eval_template.answer_resolves_question.id
  llm_connection_id = oodle_genai_llm_connection.openai.id

  enabled                  = true
  target_type              = "trace"
  sampling_rate            = 0.1
  max_invocations_per_hour = 500

  variable_mapping = jsonencode([
    {
      templateVariable = "question"
      langfuseObject   = "trace"
      selectedColumnId = "input"
    },
    {
      templateVariable = "answer"
      langfuseObject   = "trace"
      selectedColumnId = "output"
    },
  ])
}

# An Oodle-managed template can be used instead of your own.
resource "oodle_genai_evaluator" "hallucination" {
  name              = "hallucination"
  eval_template_id  = "oodle-managed-hallucination-v1"
  llm_connection_id = oodle_genai_llm_connection.openai.id
  sampling_rate     = 0.05
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `eval_template_id` (String) ID of the eval template to run. Use the id of an oodle_genai_eval_template, or the id of an Oodle-managed template. Cannot be changed after creation.
- `name` (String) Name of the evaluator.

### Optional

- `dataset_id` (String) Restricts the evaluator to runs over one dataset. Cannot be changed after creation.
- `depends_on_rule_ids` (List of String) IDs of evaluators that must score a span before this one runs.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the evaluator scores new traffic.
- `filters` (String) JSON array of filters selecting which spans are scored. An empty or unset value scores everything that matches target_type.
- `llm_connection_id` (String) ID of the oodle_genai_llm_connection the judge calls. Required for 'llm' templates.
- `max_invocations_per_hour` (Number) Ceiling on how many times the evaluator may run per hour.
- `model_params` (String) JSON object of model parameters overriding the template's own.
- `sampling_rate` (Number) Fraction of matching spans to score, from 0 to 1.
- `target_type` (String) What the evaluator runs against, for example 'trace'.
- `variable_mapping` (String) JSON describing how span fields populate the eval template's vars.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) ID of the evaluator.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# Evaluators are imported by id.
terraform import oodle_genai_evaluator.answer_quality 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000
```
